facts.text: The user referenced a /subscribe route that reads a website URL from a url query parameter in the request.
The user referenced calling hub.subscribe() with the subscribed website URL and the request headers.
The user referenced redirecting the user to the website they subscribed to after a successful subscription.
The user referenced rendering an error page with an error message if an error occurs during the subscription process.
The user provided an example /subscribe URL in the form https://www.mywebsite.com/subscribe?url=https://www.
The user referenced a /notify route implementation in websub-hub code.
The user referenced an app.post('/notify', ...) webhook route triggered when new content is published on a website.
The user referenced getting url and summary from req.body in the /notify route.
The user referenced calling hub.publish(url, { summary }) to notify the hub of updated content.
The user referenced returning 'Notification sent to hub' on successful hub.publish().
The user referenced returning HTTP 500 with 'Error sending notification to hub' if hub.publish() fails.
The user referenced that the /notify route sends notifications to all subscribed users via the hub.
